inputs.text: A stop-motion claymation scene of a snowman standing in a snowy field. the snowman has a carrot nose and black pebble eyes, surrounded by green pine trees. The entire world is made of hand-molded plasticine clay with soft, rounded, cartoony shapes and traditional winter colors—white snow, deep green pines, coal-black eyes, and an orange carrot nose. The clay surfaces show subtle fingerprints, thumb smears, and gentle imperfections, emphasizing a handmade, tactile feel. The snow looks slightly lumpy and sculpted rather than smooth. Warm, practical studio lighting illuminates the miniature set, with shallow depth of field and a macro-photography look, as if photographed frame-by-frame on a physical stop-motion stage. No CGI or digital smoothness—pure handcrafted clay animation.
